text: Finance says the August claims total doesn't match the clinics' own billing export. The instinct is to debug Gold first -- instead, we trace the number layer by layer.
Pull the same August date range from claims_raw, then claims_clean, then claims_summary_gold, and compare each one to the step before it, before touching a line of code.
Bronze matches the clinics' export exactly. Gold faithfully sums whatever Silver hands it. The $37,120 gap already exists inside claims_clean itself.
Same row count as Bronze, lower sum -- the signature of a negative value, not a missing row. Fourteen claims, all from one clinic, already negative on arrival.
Proven: where the gap starts, and exactly which 14 claims. Not yet proven: why claims_clean's own expectations didn't stop them. That's next.
